ratios.quote: We were in compliance with all covenants under the Credit Agreement as of March 31, 2026 (the net leverage ratio was 0.54 to 1.00, compared to a maximum net leverage ratio of 3.25 to 1.00 on a quarterly basis covering the trailing four consecutive fiscal quarters for each fiscal quarter).

parsed.notes: Maximum net leverage ratio of 3.25x may step up to 3.75x for a period following material acquisitions; the limit as of March 31, 2026 was 3.25x. The ratio is measured on a trailing four-quarter basis. There were no borrowings outstanding under the revolver. Senior Notes indenture covenants are excluded.
